design_basis: Stage131 L1 cavity edge residual reduced DFT force max error but worsened RMSE/throughput; physical triage tests whether that tail signal improves dimer smoothness or C/N rattle-relax stability.

interpretation.main_implication: The DFT benchmark force-max improvement is not enough evidence that this edge residual implementation improves physical robustness. It slightly improves C/N RMSD versus stage129 species24 but worsens rattle max fmax and halves throughput.
interpretation.priority_update: Do not continue by simply adding more L2/L3 edge residual paths. Move to cheaper projection/cost diagnostics for edge sketches, broader teacher trajectory/Jacobian distillation, or front representation learning that targets high-force tails without C/N-specific overfitting.
interpretation.result: Stage131 L1 edge residual does not pass the physical gate. Dimer scan remains smooth/repulsive, but C/N rattle force spikes remain large.
